intro: Track your daily income and expenses and understand where your money goes.
emailHint: Your email can be used when sharing monthly reports.
localNote: Private by design. Your data stays on this device.
dateHint: YYYY-MM-DD · today or earlier in the open month

currencySettings.label: Currency
currencySettings.warning: Your existing transaction amounts will not be converted. Only the currency used to display them will change.

essentialHint: Necessary for daily life: rent, groceries, medicine, and bills.
optionalHint: Spending you could avoid: entertainment, snacks, and optional shopping.
deleteWarning: Delete this transaction? This cannot be undone.
emptyHint: Add an income or expense to see your month take shape.
mustClose: Close the previous month before adding transactions for {{month}}.
nextMonth: Your month is closed. You can add transactions when {{month}} begins.
closeWarning: Closing {{month}} will generate your monthly reports and clear {{month}} transactions from this device. This cannot be undone.
finalWarning: Both reports are saved on this device. Export them now to keep a separate copy. Closing permanently clears this month's transactions. Have you saved what you need?
closeAvailable: Month closing is available on the last day of the month or later. You can generate reports at any time.
noReports: No reports yet. Generate your first monthly report above.
reportHint: Reports are retained on this device. Share a copy to keep it safe if the app is removed.

validation.email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
validation.date: Enter a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
validation.month: Choose a date in the open month.
validation.category: Choose a category for this transaction type.
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, up to 999,999,999.99, with at most two decimal places.

errors.title: Something needs attention
errors.storage: We couldn't read or save your local data. Existing data has not been reset. Please retry. If this continues, preserve the app data and contact support.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.report: Unable to generate the report. Please try again.
errors.share: The report could not be shared. Check that the file and a sharing app are available.
errors.monthBlocked: Close the previous month before adding new transactions, or wait until the next open month begins.
errors.missing: This transaction is no longer available.
errors.staleReport: Transactions have changed. Generate fresh reports before closing.
errors.closeTooEarly: You can close this month on its last day or later.
